title: News at 11 cover art
lede: Cat System Corp.’s 9/11 album: a VHS-degraded American flag in a rounded TV frame, with a Japanese obi strip down the left edge.
summary: VHS-smeared flag in a CRT frame, Japanese obi strip, weather-channel logos. 2016.

evidence.note: Inspected the 1200 × 1200 cover on the album’s [Bandcamp page](https://catsystemcorp.bandcamp.com/album/news-at-11), in a scratchpad copy. Not stored. The creator’s name comes from the Commons file [Cat System Corp. - News at 11 cassette artwork (flag only).jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cat_System_Corp._-_News_at_11_cassette_artwork_(flag_only).jpg).

styles.note: Partial fit, from the signalwave and mallsoft branches: VHS degradation, a CRT frame, and Japanese text are clear, but the palette is dark red, white, and blue instead of pastel.

context: Wikipedia: “One vaporwave album that directly interrogates 9/11 is News at 11 (2016) by Cat System Corp.” The label is Geometric Lullaby; the release date is September 11, 2016. [Wikipedia: Vaporwave](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vaporwave); [Wikipedia: News at 11](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/News_at_11_(album)).
observed: A waving American flag, smeared and colour-shifted like a worn VHS frame, fills a rounded-rectangle screen shape on black.
NEWS AT 11 sits below in white, narrow, pixel-like capitals.
A white obi strip on the left carries vertical katakana, a small flag, CATCORP and LOCAL 11 WEATHER logos, track lists in serif capitals, and the Geometric Lullaby logo.
interpretation: It shows the style’s darker side: the same devices (Japanese packaging, broadcast artefacts) used for mourning instead of play. The obi strip imitates Japanese import records.
borrow: Add a narrow vertical strip of small, dense label text beside a large image to imitate an import-record obi.

rights.statement: Copyrighted album art. No image is stored here.
